errors.text_span: “裳古”、“umy”、“华山”、“嘉兴”、“临安”、“江南”、“宋州”、“喜州”、“重阳”、“中原”、“南山”
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies many of the locations on the x-axis. For example, it lists "裳古" instead of "蒙古", "umy" instead of "襄阳", "宋州" instead of "牛家村", and "喜州" instead of "重阳宫". It also misrepresents the last few labels.
The description states the y-axis interval is 100, but the tick marks on the chart are at 0, 200, 400, 600, 800, and 1000, indicating an interval of 200.
The description states the height of the first bar (for 蒙古) is approximately 800, but the bar clearly extends above the 1000 mark on the y-axis.
The description states the height of the second bar (for 襄阳) is approximately 200, but the bar's height is clearly much closer to 300.
The description claims the remaining bars have a height of about 100. This is an over-generalization, as several bars are visibly lower than 100, in the 65-75 range.

errors.text_span: 柱状图未按任何特定方式排序
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the bars are not sorted in any particular way, when they are clearly sorted in descending order of value.
The description uses "灰白色" (gray-white) to describe the bar color, which is less precise than "灰色" (gray). The bars are a solid medium gray color.
